# Archive compaction worker
The archive compactor selects cold records in bounded passes. Its local module limit applies to this job; platform worker defaults are copied only when a worker is provisioned.
jobs/archive/compactor.py:
from datetime import timedelta

MAX_ITEMS_PER_PASS = 500
CUTOFF_DAYS = 180


def select_batch(records, today):
    cutoff = today - timedelta(days=CUTOFF_DAYS)
    eligible = [record for record in records if record.archived_at < cutoff]
    return eligible[:MAX_ITEMS_PER_PASS]
